# opnsense_zenarmor_policies (Data Source)

Lists policies exposed by the local OPNsense Zenarmor controller.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opnsense_zenarmor_policies" "all" {}

output "zenarmor_policies" {
  value = data.opnsense_zenarmor_policies.all.policies
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identifier for this policy collection.
- `policies` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))

<a id="nestedatt--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies`

Read-Only:

- `centralized` (Boolean) Whether Zenconsole centrally manages the policy.
- `cloud_policy_id` (String) Zenconsole policy identifier, or an empty string for a local policy.
- `default` (Boolean) Whether this is Zenarmor's default policy.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is active.
- `id` (Number) Zenarmor policy identifier.
- `local_id` (Number) Local Zenarmor policy identifier.
- `name` (String) Policy name.
